items.s: Students in England who are studying undergraduate and certain postgraduate courses starting on or after 1 January 2027 to 31 July 2027 can now apply for the Lifelong Learning Entitlement (LLE) to fund their studies.

items.t: The Welsh Rugby Union pledge support to the armed forces community
items.s: The Welsh Rugby Union has joined a network of more than 700 Welsh employers to pledge support to the armed forces community.
